items.author: @OpenAI
items.excerpt: OpenAI models helped researchers—operating as part of our Patch the Planet initiative—discover critical security flaws in PHP, an open-source programming language used to run an estimated 70% of websites. Over the past two months, we led a coalition of maintainers, researchers, and security providers to prepare fixes and protections ahead of disclosure. This duration was necessary because the fix was quite intricate and required a major change to the PHP engine. Every site using PHP can now safely upgrade their version to stay secure, in addition to applying mitigations from various security vendors. Due to the severity of these flaws and PHP’s widespread use, we consider this bug to be one of the most impactful vulnerabilities in recent memory. It also marks a new phase, where AI can find security bugs with internet-scale impact. This is an example of the Defender’s Window in action: to our knowledge, frontier AI was able to find this vulnerability ahead of attackers, giving defenders time to prepare.

reviews.title: 乳汁分子谱能反映母体营养与婴儿生长的共同变化
reviews.originalTitle: Shared patterns of human milk composition link mammary gland function to infant growth
reviews.authorsNote: 仅列第一作者，非完整名单。
reviews.stage: 跨队列多组学与生长轨迹分析
reviews.takeaway: 三个队列中，乳汁的共同分子变化与母体营养状态和婴儿生长相联系；乳汁不是单纯反映母亲吃了什么的固定配方。

summary.problem: 乳汁成分除了提供营养，能否反映乳腺功能及母婴健康之间的联系？
summary.method: 研究分析加拿大、巴基斯坦和布基纳法索三个队列的1543份乳样，比较乳汁分子谱、母体营养状态与婴儿生长轨迹。测量覆盖代谢物、蛋白质、微量与宏量营养素及乳寡糖，并结合轨迹建模；数据包含两项随机营养试验。
summary.findings: 不同队列出现与母体营养及婴儿生长相关的共同乳汁成分轴。模型识别出七个候选标志物，涉及乳汁合成、屏障及免疫修复功能；较高戊酰肉碱和较低泛酸也是相关信号。
summary.statistics: 1543是乳样数，不能当作1543名独立母婴。可读摘要未给每组人数、完整试验对照方案或临床效应大小；这里只报告跨队列比较与候选标志物，不量化营养补充对生长的因果效果。
summary.limitations: 多组学关联不能证明某个乳汁分子导致婴儿生长变化。泛酸—辅酶A—戊酰肉碱通路仍待功能验证；七项指标尚非家庭检测或补充营养处方，不能把队列结果直接推广到所有母婴。
summary.meaning: 先区分可随营养变化的成分、较稳定的成分及乳腺状态信号，再研究干预，不用单一分子评价乳汁质量。
